grids.title: Rapid Letter Naming
grids.instruction: Name each letter aloud as quickly and accurately as you can.

grids.title: Rapid Digit Naming
grids.instruction: Name each digit aloud as fast as possible.

grids.title: Rapid Color Naming
grids.instruction: Name the color of each box aloud as fast as possible.

grids.title: Rapid Object Naming
grids.instruction: Name each object picture aloud as quickly as you can.
